instruction: A candid medium shot of a residential outdoor scene during the day. On the right side of the frame, the woman in the black patterned blouse (R1) stands facing left, smiling warmly. On the left, the man in the dark gray puffer jacket (R2) stands in a back-three-quarters view, holding the newly acquired keys in his hand. The man and the woman shake hands in front of a white-sided house with a pink "SOLD" sign visible in the background. Natural daylight softly illuminates the scene, creating gentle shadows and a bright atmosphere with a shallow depth of field.
